items.text: For an identified selected workflow/current host, required-tool checks show available requirements and explicitly identify missing or unsupported requirements to the person. No successful compatibility claim rests on file portability or registration alone. Verify by VER-001. Sources: REQ-001; SOW-051.

verification.text: Exercise required-tool checks with an available-tool case and a missing/unsupported-tool case against identified workflow and host capability fixtures. Inspect the person-facing result and evidence basis, including the case where registration succeeds but a requirement is unavailable. Implements AC-001 using PRD.md V4-WF-04 and EXAMINATION.md V4-EXM-14.

items.text: A declared checkpoint requests its named human act and remains waiting despite direct-operation autonomy, interruption or replay until evidence shows that required act actually occurred. Verify by VER-002. Sources: REQ-002; SOW-052/SOW-053.

verification.text: Exercise checkpoint arrival under identified direct-application autonomy with no human act, then interruption/replay and later performance of the required act. Inspect request, waiting state and advancement evidence; direct permission or successful unrelated work must not release the checkpoint. Implements AC-002 using V4-WF-05, V4-HI-42 and V4-EXM-14/22.

items.text: An actual content-bound human checkpoint act is faithfully received with actor distinct from recorder; absence, a different act, tool success or changed content does not impersonate that act. Execution, acceptance, checking, approval and reliance remain independently attributable, with no invented acceptance prerequisite. Verify by VER-003. Sources: REQ-003; SOW-053.

verification.text: Inspect checkpoint evidence in a positive faithful-recording case where the person performs the act and a separate recorder preserves actor/content/scope/purpose. Compare cases of absent act, successful execution, another kind of human act and changed content. Include independently evidenced checking/approval/reliance without assuming proposal acceptance as a prerequisite; require only the applicable act's evidence, and retain visible lapse on changed bound content. Implements AC-003 using V4-AUT-03, V4-REC-05 and V4-HI-31/32/33; uses PKG-04's format without creating it.

items.text: The App-to-host transfer/adaptation contribution preserves original and revised source identities, declared requirements and checkpoint meaning, and distinguishes selected/resolved, supplied, provider-adopted and observed evidence, including unsupported receiving capability. Verify by VER-004. Sources: REQ-004; SOW-054.

verification.text: Trace an App-authored source through local transfer/adaptation fixtures and inspect original/revised identity, tool/checkpoint semantics, unsupported receiving outcome and the separate selection/resolution/supply/adoption/behavior evidence. Supply this local contribution to DEL-09-06 for its externally coordinated witness; label any unavailable live-host evidence. Implements AC-004 using V4-WF-03/04/06 and V4-EXM-14.

items.text: A host-authored workflow can be opened and refined through the App's existing draft/review/registration interface with origin and revision/replay history intact; same-name collisions do not rebind the selected source and historical human acts are not fabricated. Verify by VER-005. Sources: REQ-005; SOW-055.

verification.text: Exercise host-origin opening/refinement and return to the App's draft/registration receiving interface, with same-name source collision and interruption/revision/replay cases. Compare preserved original/revised bytes and actual act history; registration remains with DEL-02-02. Implements AC-005 using V4-WF-02/03/05/06 and V4-EXM-14.

items.text: The transfer contract and receiving behavior identify each contribution owner and retain each applicable unresolved decision's exact owner and point of need. They claim neither external construction/delivery nor joined qualification from local evidence. Verify by VER-006. Sources: REQ-006/REQ-007; SOW-051 through SOW-055 within this slice; CLM-001 through CLM-003.

verification.text: Review output/requirement ownership against CLM-001 through CLM-003 and the accepted Deliverables.csv rows; compare TBD-001 through TBD-005 and DEP-001 against frozen and current registers. Check that no policy carrier is promoted into the decision actor and no local contract implies an external commitment. Implements AC-006 using the accepted interfaces and Composite HTML decisions 02/03/05.

items.text: Candidate-bound fixtures cover the accepted missing-tool, checkpoint-hold and source-preserving transfer/refinement behaviors with actual outcomes and limitations; their evidence can be consumed by the DEL-09-06 integration owner without presenting local fixtures as the joined host round-trip witness. Verify by VER-007. Sources: OUT-003; SOW-051 through SOW-055; CLM-003.

verification.text: Inspect the candidate-bound fixture set and actual run report for the behavior coverage in VER-001 through VER-005, identifying candidate/source versions, outcomes, received evidence and missing external contributions. Check that the local evidence account names DEL-09-06 as joined witness owner and does not claim that witness occurred. Implements AC-007 using G3 Deliverables.csv DEL-02-03/DEL-09-06 and DEP-001.
